Load a schedule from a data frame or CSV file

Source: R/schedules.R
load_schedule.Rd

Required columns: provider_id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), shift_type (one of d/day/n/night/o/off). Provider-days missing from the input default to "o".

Usage

load_schedule(x, n_days, start_date = "2024-01-01")

Arguments

x

A data frame, or a path to a CSV file, with the required columns.

n_days

Integer window length.

start_date

Character or Date; day 0 of the window.

Value

A list with schedule (character providers x days matrix) and providers (character vector of ids, sorted).
